jobs.title: Operations
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-operations and systems fit: build scalable insurance workflows, SOPs and AI-enabled automation in a fast-growing healthcare startup. Strong overlap with intake operations, workflow design, process improvement and cross-functional execution.
jobs.gap: The role is startup-heavy and insurance-operations focused. Emphasize healthcare workflow ownership, process building and automation while being clear that payer operations depth is still developing.

jobs.title: Healthcare Operations Manager
jobs.why: Direct healthcare operations leadership role covering staffing, budgeting, vendor management, compliance, quality improvement and cross-functional clinical/financial operations. Healthcare experience is explicitly not required, making the transition especially realistic.
jobs.gap: The role includes full clinic financial and people-management ownership. Highlight training, healthcare operations, team coordination and process ownership; compensation should be confirmed above the $100K target.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Level II (Change Management)
jobs.location: New York, NY · Health-system based · travel up to 30%
jobs.why: Strong healthcare project-management match focused on operational and clinical effectiveness, business requirements, change management, training, stakeholder engagement and system-wide process improvement.
jobs.gap: The role prefers formal PM/change-management credentials and deeper multi-project healthcare experience. Position cumulative systems, BA, training and healthcare-operations project ownership clearly without implying PMP certification.

jobs.title: Practice Manager (FGP) - Manhattan, OBGYN
jobs.why: Direct healthcare operations role covering clinical/admin staff, scheduling, workflow analysis, new-process implementation, technology rollout, revenue-cycle monitoring, training and operational performance.
jobs.gap: NYU asks for 5–10 years of physician-practice operations and manager experience. This is a stretch on direct physician-practice tenure, so emphasize ABA healthcare operations and staff training without overstating experience.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare technology implementation role combining project plans, stakeholder communication, workflow requirements, client training, documentation and cross-functional work with Product and Engineering.
jobs.gap: Requires 5+ years of enterprise SaaS implementation plus stronger API/data-mapping and system-architecture fluency. Treat as a stretch and emphasize implementation leadership and Salesforce/workflow experience without overstating technical depth.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager, Healthcare
jobs.why: Health-tech implementation role centered on customer onboarding, workflow configuration, testing, QA, go-live readiness, documentation and coordination across Customer Success, Product and Engineering.
jobs.gap: The technical implementation scope includes integrations, telephony, IVRs and healthcare platforms. Lead with systems/project experience but do not imply engineering-level integration expertise.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong implementation/project-management fit involving end-to-end customer launches, stakeholder management, integrations, AI configuration, product setup and cross-functional work with Sales, Product and Engineering.
jobs.gap: This is outside healthcare and expects hands-on enterprise SaaS/AI implementation experience. Position AI-enabled tool building, workflow automation and project coordination as transferable rather than claiming deep technical consulting experience.

jobs.title: Regional Practice Manager – Multi-Site Healthcare Operations
jobs.why: Direct healthcare operations role overseeing staff, provider schedules, documentation and operational workflows across Brooklyn and Queens, aligning with healthcare intake, staffing coordination and process-management experience.
jobs.gap: The role seeks senior hands-on medical-practice management across multiple sites. Direct physician-practice and multi-site leadership experience is the largest gap, so this should be treated as a calculated stretch.
